name: store-locator-static-vanilla-js
description: Multi-Branch Store, ATM & Inventory Locator built with Static HTML, Vanilla JS (ES Modules), and modern Google Maps Platform APIs.

scripts.build: node --check app.js && node --check server.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { for (const f of ['index.html', 'app.js', 'styles.css', 'server.mjs']) { if (!fs.existsSync(f)) { throw new Error('Missing required asset: ' + f); } } console.log('Static assets verified.'); })"
